attributes.description: Managed Active Directory services (AWS Managed Microsoft AD, Entra Domain Services, Google Managed AD) as ciamManagedDirectory bindings: a TARGET (ciamRealizes ds) holds the platform's user directory; a NEIGHBOUR (ciamPartnerOf) is a directory the platform binds to. Trusts are entries beneath it. Cloud adapters declare dated ManagedDirectory descriptors (availability per partition, capabilities, limits, editions, default OU). The planner reads a target's needs from the record (own schema, password policies, LDAPS, regions, trusts): unsupported blocks; not established blocks until a ciamUnknown confirms; base DNs, ACIs and users are actions. Renders keep secrets out of Terraform state (AWS: a CloudFormation stack with a Secrets Manager dynamic reference; trusts and LDAPS certificates are actions). Read back from state, stacks and the AWS CLI; managed-directory report; FedRAMP boundary rows.

attributes.name: plan
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "d", "type": "Directory"}, {"name": "src_spec", "type": "str"}, {"name": "dst_spec", "type": "str"}, {"name": "as_of", "type": "date"}, {"name": "installed", "type": "Sequence[Adapter]", "required": false, "description": "default registry.ADAPTERS"}, {"name": "domains", "type": "Sequence[Domain]", "required": false, "description": "default registry.DOMAINS"}, {"name": "requester", "type": "str|None", "required": false, "description": "who runs the migration, recorded in the target's MANIFEST"}]
attributes.purpose: Migration plan with the given installed adapters (default: discovered) and domains: render both environments (the target whole, scope ENVIRONMENT, its MANIFEST naming requester when given), build a PlanContext, run cross-domain, adapter and domain checks, then the source_checks of the adapters applying to the source (a product the move retires), and the connector checks (access, edge, network, evidence, signals, log collection, SIEM indexes nothing keeps: siem_check, the target's cloud-managed identity services against the adapters' ManagedService descriptors: managed_identity_check, its cloud-managed directory services against their ManagedDirectory descriptors: managed_directory_check, proxies, upgrades, secret-store inventory with the installed adapters' locators), merge Findings into a Plan

attributes.name: pairs_resources
attributes.purpose: (resources, notices) of (Terraform resource type, attributes) pairs: what every AWS source is read into (state as is; CLI output and CloudFormation normalized to the same names), IAM included (iam_resources), the network depth (network_resources: route tables, NACLs, VPC endpoints, endpoint services, Network Firewall allowlists, links, flow logs; endpoint security groups left out of the firewall rules), managed databases, Cognito user pools as managed identity services (cognito.cognito_resources), AWS Managed Microsoft AD directories as managed directories (directory.directory_resources: aws_directory_service_directory, or an opsdir directory stack), S3 buckets with their settings (storage.object_store_resources), NAT allocation static for a public NAT gateway, audit trails, security services and budgets (budgets.budget_resources; their SNS topics are alert channels).

attributes.name: cli_resources
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "texts", "type": "dict", "description": "{path within <cloud>/<env>/: text}"}, {"name": "at", "type": "datetime", "required": false, "description": "the import's time (dates evaluator verdicts)"}]
attributes.purpose: (Resources, notices) of an environment's AWS CLI outputs: recognized by top-level key, or by the folder they are saved under (a bucket's s3api settings; DLM policies; GuardDuty detectors and organization configurations), normalized to Terraform pairs (IAM, the simulator's verdicts dated by at, Instance Connect Endpoints as access paths; databases; bucket settings; CloudTrail trails; autoscaling groups, launch template versions and EKS; alarms, log groups, canaries and SNS topics; GuardDuty, Inspector, Config and Security Hub; SQS queues, EventBridge buses, Kinesis streams and SES identities; Cognito user pools from the projected describe-user-pool: cli_cognito.cognito_pairs; managed Microsoft AD directories from the projected describe-directories and their tags: cli_directory.directory_pairs; EventBridge rules with their event patterns; Lambda tags), scoped to the listed VPCs (a directory by its VPC too), read by the shared mapping.

attributes.name: pairs_resources
attributes.purpose: (resources, notices) of (Terraform resource type, attributes) pairs: what every Azure source is read into, access control included (iam_resources), the network depth (network_resources: route tables, private endpoints, Private Link Services, Firewall policy allowlists, peering/VPN/hub links, flow logs), managed databases, Entra Domain Services managed domains as managed directories (domain_services.domain_service_resources), blob containers (object_store_resources), Activity Log diagnostic settings as audit trails (trail_resources), security services, Log Analytics workspaces (a SIEM index when Sentinel is onboarded) and Sentinel scheduled analytics rules as detections (sentinel_resources), consumption budgets, NAT allocation static.

attributes.name: pairs_resources
attributes.purpose: (resources, notices) of (Terraform resource type, attributes) pairs: what every Google Cloud source is read into, IAM included (iam_resources), the network depth (network_inventory.network_resources with instance roles, network-tag roles and proxy-only subnets: policy firewall rules by secure tag, network/hierarchical policies, the policy's egress allowlist, routes, PSC for Google APIs (not services), service attachments, links, subnet flow logs), managed databases, Managed Microsoft AD domains as managed directories (managed_ad.managed_ad_resources), Cloud Storage buckets with versioning, retention, key, lifecycle and public access prevention (storage.object_store_resources), log sinks exporting Cloud Audit Logs as audit trails (audit.trail_resources), Cloud NAT allocation (MANUAL_ONLY static, AUTO_ONLY automatic); roles from labels (names.label_tags).

attributes.name: render_files
attributes.purpose: {path: TfFile | text} of environment m's AWS render: the stack's providers (the default, the us-east-1 alias, backup copy regions, billing, the organization's management and security administrator accounts when recorded (account.organization_providers), and one per region security services in every region run in (security.every_region / region_alias); each root keeps those it uses) and main items (ending with the Cognito user pools running identity services: cognito.render_cognito, and the AWS Managed Microsoft AD directories holding the user directory: directory.render_directories) plus the landing zone's and plumbing keepers' parts (landing_parts) placed into roots by who keeps what (landing.placed_roots: the stack's root, each taking keeper's terraform/landing-zone[/<party>]/, named keepers in a stack comment), the scripts and handlers they package as text (copied into a keeper root that reads them: carried_files), evaluation files. Under a keeper, class or bindings scope: the scope's root and the files it reads only.

attributes.name: render_files
attributes.purpose: {path: TfFile | text} of environment m's Google Cloud render: the stack's providers (archive when synthetic monitors package source) and main items (uptime checks, synthetic monitors: render_monitors; the Managed Microsoft AD domains holding the user directory: managed_ad.render_managed_ad, after the databases) plus the landing zone's and plumbing keepers' parts (landing_parts) placed into roots by who keeps what (landing.placed_roots: the stack's root, each taking keeper's terraform/landing-zone[/<party>]/, named keepers in a stack comment), the workflow and synthetic monitor source files as text (copied into a keeper root that reads them: carried_files), evaluation files. Under a keeper, class or bindings scope: the scope's root and the files it reads only.

attributes.name: data_stack_pairs
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "declared", "type": "list[(logical id, type, resolved, raw, physical id)]", "required": true}, {"name": "names", "type": "dict", "required": true}]
attributes.purpose: (Terraform resource type, attributes) pairs of the data stores among a stack's declared resources, in the names databases.database_resources, discovery, cognito.cognito_resources and directory.directory_resources read (5.6c): RDS DBInstance (aws_db_instance, or aws_rds_cluster_instance for an Aurora member), DBCluster, DBSubnetGroup, DB/DBCluster parameter groups (their Parameters), Macie CustomDataIdentifier, Cognito UserPool (id, ARN, name, tags) and UserPoolDomain (domain, pool, certificate), DirectoryService MicrosoftAD (aws_directory_service_directory: ID, domain, NetBIOS name, edition, VPC; never its Password); ARNs from Fn::GetAtt by type.

attributes.name: render_notes
attributes.purpose: Adapter notes of the AWS adapter (Adapter.notes, flow 43): what environment m's AWS render leaves out or to a person, each written as its comment: the canaries it doesn't render (canary_notes), then the security services' (security_notes), audit trails' (audit_notes), data discovery's (discovery_notes), guardrails' (guardrail_notes), alert rules' (alert_notes), log destinations' (log_group_notes), identities' (core identity_notes), Kubernetes-only roles' (core kubernetes_notes), budgets' (budget_notes), forwarders on its own DNS servers' (dns.forwarder_notes), databases' (database_notes), Cognito user pools' (cognito.cognito_notes: scopes renamed, partner metadata URLs, neighbours not rendered), managed directories' (directory.directory_notes: trusts, LDAPS, schema, password policies, domain controllers, region variables, the Admin password's reference, neighbours not rendered), backup plans' (backup_notes), volumes' (volume_notes), compute groups' (group_notes), service names' edges' (edge_notes), the stack's network depth's (network.network_notes) and the landing zone plumbing's (plumbing.plumbing_notes) and, in GovCloud with a CDN, CloudFront's (cdn.govcloud_note) notes, and with Services the servers' and Fluent Bit's log shipping notes.

attributes.name: render_notes
attributes.purpose: Adapter notes (flow 43): what environment m's Azure render leaves out or to a person, as data: synthetic checks, check jobs, security services', audit trails', data discovery's, suppressions', guardrails', alert rules', workspaces', Sentinel's (sentinel_notes), identities', Kubernetes-only roles', unpinned priorities', budgets, FIPS, forwarders, backups, databases, Entra External ID tenants' (external_id.external_id_notes: what to create by hand, neighbours not rendered), Entra Domain Services managed domains' (domain_services.domain_service_notes: prerequisites, secure LDAP, trusts, password policies, OU, replica set subnets, neighbours not rendered), volumes, groups, edges, quotas, network depth and plumbing notes, the landing zone's placed notes and log shipping's (servers, containers); each written as its comment.

attributes.name: render_notes
attributes.purpose: Adapter notes of the Google Cloud adapter (Adapter.notes, flow 43): what environment m's render leaves out or to a person, each written as its comment: uptime checks (uptime_notes) and synthetic monitors (monitor_notes) it doesn't render, then the security services', audit trails', data discovery's, guardrails', Assured Workloads workload's, alert rules', identities' (core identity_notes), Kubernetes-only roles' (core kubernetes_notes; VPC firewall rules only under the VPC model), firewall rules' (firewall_notes: priorities, the policy model's tag bindings), budgets' (budget_notes), FIPS endpoints' (account.fips_note), forwarders on its own DNS servers' (dns.forwarder_notes), databases', Managed Microsoft AD domains' (managed_ad.managed_ad_notes: trusts, LDAPS, schema, password policies, neighbours not rendered), backup vaults' and plans', volumes', compute groups', service names' edges' (edge_notes), failover records' (dns.failover_notes), unrendered quota requests' (quota_notes), the stack's network depth's (network.network_notes) and the landing zone plumbing's (plumbing.plumbing_notes) notes, and with Services the log shipping notes (log_sink_notes).

attributes.name: terraform_parts
attributes.purpose: (parts, landing_dns, interconnect lines, scripts, container files) of environment m's Azure Terraform before it is placed: the stack's providers (azapi also for an external tenant, azuread also for its app registrations, each External ID target's aliased azuread provider) and main items (network, servers, groups, backups, services, databases, object stores, DNS, trails, workspaces, log collection, container logs, alerts, Sentinel onboarding and analytics rules: render_sentinel, web tests, check jobs, security, discovery, Purview, suppressions, budgets, quota requests, Key Vault secrets, the Entra External ID targets: render_external_id, and last the Entra Domain Services managed domains: domain_services.render_domain_services) and the landing zone's and plumbing keepers' parts.
attributes.returns: {"type": "tuple", "description": "(parts, landing_dns, interconnect header lines, check scripts {path: text}, container files {path: text})"}

attributes.name: status
attributes.purpose: (status, source) of a capability on a managed service (ManagedService or ManagedDirectory) in a partition: unsupported (partition or service documented), not established where the partition's documentation leaves open what is documented elsewhere (partition_unestablished, its why as the source), supported, else not established.

attributes.name: availability
attributes.purpose: (status, source) of a managed service existing in a partition: documented absent, documented available, else not established.

attributes.name: question_name
attributes.purpose: The name of the unknowns-register question confirming a capability of a managed identity binding in an environment: managed_service.question_name with the capability's slug.

attributes.name: managed_identity_check
attributes.purpose: The planner check of the target's managed identity services given the adapters rendering it (their ManagedService descriptors): targets' coverage, availability, published hosts, actions; neighbours' part; undeclared services blocked.

attributes.name: _gap
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "ctx", "type": "PlanContext", "required": true}, {"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true}, {"name": "b", "type": "Entry", "required": true}, {"name": "spec", "type": "ManagedService", "required": true}, {"name": "partition", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "capability", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "needs", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "concerns", "type": "tuple[str]", "required": true}, {"name": "owner_entries", "type": "tuple[Entry]", "required": true}, {"name": "change", "type": "str", "required": true}]
attributes.purpose: The finding for one capability of a managed identity service: connectors.managed_service.gap in this check's Voice (VOICE), the capability's slug for its question.

attributes.name: _available
attributes.purpose: The finding for a managed identity service existing in the environment's partition: connectors.managed_service.available in this check's Voice.

attributes.name: question_name
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true}, {"name": "b", "type": "Entry", "required": true, "description": "the binding"}, {"name": "capability", "type": "str", "required": true, "description": "the capability as a name part (its slug), or 'available'"}]
attributes.purpose: The name of the unknowns-register question confirming a capability of a managed-service binding in an environment: confirm-<cloud>-<env>-<binding>-<slug>.

attributes.name: owners
attributes.purpose: The owner DNs of the first of these entries that has any.

attributes.name: confirm_fix
attributes.purpose: The Fix adding the blocking ciamUnknown question that confirms a capability (owner given as an Input when none is recorded), with its manual steps (in the check's voice: what changing the record instead means) and risks.

attributes.name: confirmed
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "ctx", "type": "PlanContext", "required": true}, {"name": "voice", "type": "Voice", "required": true}, {"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true}, {"name": "b", "type": "Entry", "required": true}, {"name": "capability", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "slug", "type": "str", "required": true, "description": "the capability as a question name's part"}, {"name": "needs", "type": "str", "required": true, "description": "the finding's opening: who needs what of the binding"}, {"name": "concerns", "type": "tuple[str]", "required": true}, {"name": "owner_entries", "type": "tuple[Entry]", "required": true}]
attributes.purpose: The finding for a capability no vendor documentation establishes: ok when an answered question confirms it, nothing while an open blocking question asks it (the register counts it), else a blocker offering the question as its fix.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "ctx", "type": "PlanContext", "required": true}, {"name": "voice", "type": "Voice", "required": true}, {"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true}, {"name": "b", "type": "Entry", "required": true}, {"name": "spec", "type": "ManagedService | ManagedDirectory", "required": true}, {"name": "partition", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "capability", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "slug", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "needs", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "concerns", "type": "tuple[str]", "required": true}, {"name": "owner_entries", "type": "tuple[Entry]", "required": true}, {"name": "change", "type": "str", "required": true}]
attributes.purpose: The finding for one capability of a managed service in a partition: nothing when supported (an action when only on a condition), a blocker when documented unsupported (change: what to do instead), else the confirmation path.

attributes.name: available
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "ctx", "type": "PlanContext", "required": true}, {"name": "voice", "type": "Voice", "required": true}, {"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true}, {"name": "b", "type": "Entry", "required": true}, {"name": "spec", "type": "ManagedService | ManagedDirectory", "required": true}, {"name": "partition", "type": "str", "required": true}]
attributes.purpose: The finding for a managed service existing in the environment's partition: documented absent a blocker (run it elsewhere, in the check's voice), not established a blocker until an answered question confirms it.

attributes.name: undeclared
attributes.purpose: The blocker for a binding whose ciamManagedService no adapter rendering the environment declares.

attributes.name: managed_directories
attributes.purpose: Environment m's managed directory bindings (ciamManagedDirectory).

attributes.name: is_target
attributes.purpose: Whether a managed directory binding holds the platform's user directory (ciamRealizes): a target, not a neighbour.

attributes.name: realizes_directory
attributes.purpose: Whether a target binding realizes the directory server role ds (the only role a managed directory can hold).

attributes.name: partners
attributes.purpose: The integrations a neighbour managed directory is the partner side of (ciamPartnerOf, those the record holds), in record order.

attributes.name: trusts
attributes.purpose: A managed directory's trusts (ciamDirectoryTrust entries beneath its binding), in DN order.

attributes.name: trust_capability
attributes.purpose: The capability a directory trust needs: trust:<type>:<direction>.

attributes.name: words
attributes.purpose: A managed-directory capability in words: what the service would have to do (a trust by its direction and type).

attributes.name: slug
attributes.purpose: A managed-directory capability as a question name's part (colons as hyphens).

attributes.name: domain_dn
attributes.purpose: An Active Directory domain's DN from its DNS name (corp.example.com -> DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com).

attributes.name: custom_schema
attributes.purpose: The record's own user-directory attribute types and object classes: the ou=user-schema records with an OID of their own (ciamLdapOid), in DN order.

attributes.name: password_policies
attributes.purpose: The record's declared password policies (ciamPasswordPolicy under the declared configuration), in DN order.

attributes.name: target_needs
attributes.purpose: The capabilities the record needs of the managed directory a target binding is, as Needs in order: schema extension (own OIDs), fine-grained password policies (more than one, or one for a population), secure LDAP (and to the internet), further regions, each trust.

attributes.name: neighbour_needs
attributes.purpose: The capabilities a neighbour managed directory needs to play its part: LDAP for each ldap integration it is the partner side of, then each trust.

attributes.name: tls_only_consumers
attributes.purpose: The record's directory consumers seen connecting only with TLS (ciamTlsOnly), in DN order.

attributes.name: moved_bases
attributes.purpose: Each base DN of the record's declared backends not under the OU the platform writes in, with the consumers whose bind DN or searched subtrees name it.

attributes.name: acis
attributes.purpose: The record's ACIs (ciamAci under ou=acis), in DN order.

attributes.name: managed_rows
attributes.purpose: Report managed-directory: one row per managed directory binding of every environment (service, target or neighbour, realizes/partner of, domain, edition, regions, trusts, kept by, resource).

attributes.name: managed_directory_check
attributes.purpose: The planner check of the target's managed directory services given the adapters rendering it (their ManagedDirectory descriptors): targets' availability, record needs (gaps, editions, limits), base DNs, ACIs, TLS-only consumers, notes, users; neighbours' LDAP and trusts; undeclared services blocked.

attributes.name: _edition
attributes.purpose: The finding for a capability only some editions have: a blocker when the binding records another edition, an action when it records none.

attributes.name: _limit
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "ctx", "type": "PlanContext", "required": true}, {"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true}, {"name": "b", "type": "Entry", "required": true}, {"name": "spec", "type": "ManagedDirectory", "required": true}, {"name": "key", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "count", "type": "int", "required": true}, {"name": "what", "type": "str", "required": true}]
attributes.purpose: The blocker for a binding needing more of something (password policies, regions, trusts) than the service takes (spec.limits), else nothing.

attributes.name: _need
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "ctx", "type": "PlanContext", "required": true}, {"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true}, {"name": "b", "type": "Entry", "required": true}, {"name": "spec", "type": "ManagedDirectory", "required": true}, {"name": "partition", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "need", "type": "Need", "required": true}, {"name": "change", "type": "str", "required": true, "description": "what to do instead when the capability is documented unsupported"}]
attributes.purpose: The findings for one Need of a managed directory: the capability's gap (managed_service.gap; change: what to do instead, TARGET_CHANGE or NEIGHBOUR_CHANGE), the edition it takes and the service's limit on it.

attributes.name: _bases
attributes.purpose: Actions for the record's base DNs moving under the OU the platform writes in (ciamWritableBase or the service's default), naming the consumers whose binds or searches change; an action to record the OU when none is known.

attributes.name: _carried
attributes.purpose: Actions for what doesn't carry onto a managed directory: the record's ACIs (re-create as delegation), TLS-only consumers where secure LDAP is off.

attributes.name: _target
attributes.purpose: Findings for a binding holding the platform's user directory on a managed directory service: it realizes ds, availability, needs, trust limit, base DNs, what doesn't carry, notes, users, ok line.

attributes.name: _neighbour
attributes.purpose: Findings for a neighbour managed directory: availability, LDAP for its partner integrations, its trusts and the trust limit, ok line with its keeper.

attributes.name: netbios
attributes.purpose: A managed directory's NetBIOS name: ciamNetbiosName, else the first label of its domain in capitals (AWS's default), at most 15 characters.

attributes.name: directory_bindings
attributes.purpose: Environment m's AWS Managed Microsoft AD bindings (ciamManagedDirectory of service aws-managed-ad).

attributes.name: password_reference
attributes.purpose: The CloudFormation Secrets Manager dynamic reference ({{resolve:secretsmanager:<id>}}) to the Admin password: the credential role's aws-sm secret, or None.

attributes.name: directory_template
attributes.purpose: The CloudFormation template of a target's directory: AWS::DirectoryService::MicrosoftAD (Retain on delete/replace) with its domain, NetBIOS name, edition, the Terraform VPC/subnet data sources and the password's dynamic reference; outputs its ID and DNS addresses only.

attributes.name: render_directories
attributes.purpose: HCL for environment m's AWS Managed Microsoft AD targets (aws_cloudformation_stack, aws_directory_service_region on variables, aws_directory_service_conditional_forwarder per trust with DNS servers), each stamped with its entry; a neighbour's note as a comment.

attributes.name: directory_notes
attributes.purpose: The render notes of environment m's AWS Managed Microsoft AD directories: each target's (missing inputs, Admin password handling, trusts, LDAPS, schema, password policies, domain controllers, region variables) and a neighbour's.

attributes.name: directory_resources
attributes.purpose: Managed directory resources of (Terraform type, attributes) pairs: aws_directory_service_directory of type MicrosoftAD (state, CloudFormation importer, CLI) or an opsdir directory stack (aws_cloudformation_stack: its template and outputs), by ID: domain, NetBIOS name, edition, regions, tagged role and Realizes; never the password.

attributes.name: _target
attributes.purpose: A target's render items: its notes as comments, then the directory stack, region and forwarders, or an UNBOUND comment naming what it records too little of.

attributes.name: _notes
attributes.purpose: The render notes of an AWS Managed Microsoft AD target.

attributes.name: _stacked
attributes.purpose: The aws_directory_service_directory pair an opsdir directory stack in state declares (its template's MicrosoftAD properties, the directory ID from its outputs), or None; its Password isn't read.

attributes.name: directory_pairs
attributes.purpose: The (Terraform type, attributes) pairs of the managed Microsoft AD directories among recognized AWS CLI outputs (describe-directories projected, tags from directory-tags/<id>.json); Simple AD and AD Connector skipped.

attributes.name: domain_service_bindings
attributes.purpose: Environment m's Entra Domain Services bindings (ciamManagedDirectory of service entra-domain-services).

attributes.name: render_domain_services
attributes.purpose: HCL for environment m's Entra Domain Services targets (azurerm_active_directory_domain_service hardened, secure LDAP ignored; replica sets on subnet variables), each stamped with its entry; a neighbour's note as a comment.

attributes.name: domain_service_notes
attributes.purpose: The render notes of environment m's Entra Domain Services managed domains: each target's (prerequisites, secure LDAP, trusts, password policies, OU, replica set subnets) and a neighbour's.

attributes.name: domain_service_resources
attributes.purpose: Managed directory resources of (Terraform type, attributes) pairs: one per azurerm_active_directory_domain_service by ID: domain, SKU as edition, region, replica sets' regions, tagged role and Realizes; never secure LDAP's certificate or password.

attributes.name: _domain
attributes.purpose: The azurerm_active_directory_domain_service block of a target: name, region, resource group, domain, SKU (UNBOUND when no edition), initial replica set subnet, notifications, hardened security, tags, ignore_changes secure_ldap.

attributes.name: _notes
attributes.purpose: The render notes of an Entra Domain Services target.

attributes.name: partition
attributes.purpose: Where environment m's Google Cloud resources run as far as the managed directory goes: assured:<regime> when its required authorization level asks for an Assured Workloads package, else public.

attributes.name: managed_ad_bindings
attributes.purpose: Environment m's Managed Microsoft AD bindings (ciamManagedDirectory of service google-managed-ad).

attributes.name: render_managed_ad
attributes.purpose: HCL for environment m's Managed Microsoft AD targets (google_active_directory_domain: domain, regions, reserved range, the network authorized, deletion protection, labels), each stamped with its entry; a neighbour's note as a comment.

attributes.name: managed_ad_notes
attributes.purpose: The render notes of environment m's Managed Microsoft AD domains: each target's (trusts, LDAPS, schema, password policies) and a neighbour's.

attributes.name: managed_ad_resources
attributes.purpose: Managed directory resources of (Terraform type, attributes) pairs: one per google_active_directory_domain by resource name: domain, first and further regions, reserved range, labelled role and realized role.

attributes.name: _notes
attributes.purpose: The render notes of a Managed Microsoft AD target.

attributes.name: binding_labels
attributes.purpose: The labels a rendered Google Cloud binding carries: its role (label-safe), managed_by opsdir, then any more given.

attributes.name: label_tags
attributes.purpose: A resource's labels as the core's tag names (Role, BindingRole, Realizes): what readers read its role by.

attributes.name: trust_summary

attributes.description: Milestone 111's managed-directories slice (deferred note 3100). Model the clouds' managed Active Directory services as data on the LDAP base: as a TARGET realizing a directory role (what the record's directory needs that the service can or can't take: schema extensions, OUs the operator may write, LDAPS, password policy/fine-grained policies, trusts, replication/regions, admin rights left to the customer) and as a NEIGHBOUR (hybrid identity: a directory the platform binds to or syncs from, kept by another team). Cloud adapters declare each service as a dated descriptor with availability per partition (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, Google Cloud Assured Workloads), like the managed identity services (flow 66, connectors/managed_identity.py); the planner blocks what the target can't keep; render where the providers allow (aws_directory_service_directory, azurerm_active_directory_domain_service, google_active_directory_domain) and name the rest as actions; read back where sound. Research first via Codex (read-only): each service's current limits (schema extension support, LDAPS, delegated OU, trusts, sizes/editions, regions incl. GovCloud/Azure Government), Terraform resources at their current provider releases. Design to the master before coding (it changes what the record holds); propose whether this is a new flow (likely: Managed Directory Services) with its themes. Google Identity Platform stays for a later task.
